title: Brighter Light Does Not Help
summary: Guess what the ammeter will do, then run it. Below a threshold frequency no brightness ejects a single electron, and above it the electron energy ignores brightness entirely.

sources.title: Einstein, On a Heuristic Point of View Concerning the Production and Transformation of Light, Annalen der Physik 17 (1905)
